0022600109.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-1, 11th in the West) are on the road against the Dallas Mavericks (1-1, 8th in the West), who are on a one-game win streak and are 0.5 games back in the Southwest, while the Spurs sit 1 game back. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and in 2025-26 the Spurs won 4-0, including a 139-120 win in San Antonio on April 10. Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain) are out for San Antonio, and Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb, sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder, soreness), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (calf, soreness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation).
